topic: Museu das Favelas e EY Brasil anunciam inscrições para curso gratuito de audiovisual Notícia Preta Brasil
insights: Museu das Favelas and EY Brasil are offering a free audiovisual course aimed at residents of favelas and peripheral areas.
The course has opened 50 free spots for participants aged 16 to 24.
Applications for the course are open until July 27, with a second round of applications scheduled from September 1 to 10.

quotes.text: The program Favela Inteligência Ancestral encourages the creation of individual or collective audiovisual projects.

summary: Museu das Favelas and EY Brasil have launched a free audiovisual course targeting young residents of favelas and peripheral areas in São Paulo. The initiative aims to empower participants through creative projects and technical training, with applications currently open.

signal.title: Museu das Favelas e EY Brasil anunciam inscrições para curso gratuito de audiovisual
